paragraphs: SaraWorks sells client communication software that brings texts, emails, appointment bookings and reminders, video calls, e-signatures and document uploads into one secure hub. SaraWorks automatically logs caseworker and client activity as case notes in the agency CMS or system of record. The same section lists service tracking, IEP/IPE meeting documentation, post-exit follow-up and employment outcomes, and RSA reporting and client surveys.

The homepage states that the product helps vocational rehabilitation, workforce development agencies and boards do more. Two sections invite readers to learn more about SaraWorks for vocational rehabilitation agencies and for workforce development agencies and WDBs. A testimonial on that page is attributed to a business process analyst at the Nevada Department of Employment, Training & Rehabilitation.

On security, the pages state that the software is 508-compliant, hosted in FedRAMP-approved AWS GovCloud, and NIST 800-53 and HIPAA-compliant. The same list states an Authority to Operate from the VA.

quote.text: Sara was the tool that we could use that allowed us to communicate without using personnel resources.
